Mod.Name: 奢侈品奥克莫吸注射器 / Luxury Nomore Injector
Mod.Author: harness
Mod.Description: 把「奥克莫吸注射器」归类为奢侈品，并给它加价：基础价值 50 × 倍数，默认 4 倍＝200。倍数在模组设置里可调（1 到 10 倍，1 倍＝不加价），和赛纳普斯注射器同档，摆上柜台能吸引买奢侈品的客人。 Marks the Nomore Injector as a luxury item and applies a configurable markup: base value 50 x multiplier, default 4x = 200. The multiplier is a mod setting (1-10x, 1x = no markup), matching the Synaprest Injector tier.
